rv.q: But for that to be found, this cluttered, scattered, far-from-ready show will have to get out of its own way.
There are moments when the show charms. But there is also something lacking at the core.
Court Theatre's refreshing new musical Out Here is a must see this spring.
I can see "Out Here" making its way on Broadway, as this unconventional musical production captivates audiences with its remarkable wit, exquisite dialogue and charm.
In its innovative structure and wavering characters, it fills a huge empty hole in the tales of our lives.
I had such an enjoyable time at the show that I cannot not recommend it.
Under the thoughtful direction of Chay Yew, Out Here is stellar at evoking a mood of emotional instability.
Chay Yew’s interesting production of OUT HERE is definitely entertaining, but might be deceptively labeled as a musical.
Once again, this is a new work, recently designed for this opening, and you can help it grow, just by being there .

cn.t: This ambitious new musical about a woman coming out and divorcing earns praise for its innovative meta-theatricality and honest storytelling, though critics split on whether its unconventional structure fully works.
